tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — the black stage in Night, the white studio in Studio.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and table rows that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, meter tracks, serial plates, read-only fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) — ≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and secondary metadata on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥5:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view: a white button on the black stage, a black button in the studio. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (17:1).

tokens.name: metal
tokens.usage: Brushed-silver accent: thin rules, spec-sheet dimension lines, the cover's metal block, decorative marks. Not for body text.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Inverse bands: the Studio app rail and term-sheet header (black on white); a lifted band in Night.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text on `graphite` (≥14:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The status light — the only hue in the brand. Links, focus, live/connected indicators, and the Healthy state. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥5.4:1).

tokens.name: ltv-safe
tokens.usage: Healthy loan-to-value: text, meter fill, badge. The status light, so Healthy is blue — never green.

tokens.name: ltv-safe-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Healthy badge; `ltv-safe` text on it.

tokens.name: ltv-watch
tokens.usage: Watch state — LTV past the watch threshold. Text, meter fill, icon.

tokens.name: ltv-watch-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Watch badge; `ltv-watch` text on it.

tokens.name: ltv-call
tokens.usage: Margin call / default, failed payments, destructive actions and errors. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: ltv-call-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Margin call badge and error banners; `ltv-call` text on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥5.4:1 on every surface).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name only, in capitals, wide-tracked. Nothing else is set in Michroma except the cover.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes only. One per page. Light weight, never bold.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We value the robot, not just your credit file.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Valuation refreshed 2 hours ago from telemetry.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and stat labels, badges and button text. Always in capitals.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Headline money and percentages: valuation, principal, LTV.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Figures inside body copy and tables — tabular, right-aligned.

styles.name: serial
styles.usage: Serial numbers, asset IDs, loan IDs, hashes. Usually capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls, between stacked label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, between form fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop, space between major sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing section padding — the brand runs on empty space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, serial plates, meter tracks, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. Near-square — precision hardware, not pillows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards. In Night, separation comes from `line` and `surface-raised`, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.
